description: Structured Pydantic schema for TrendAnalysisAgent output.

current_trends.description: Current active trends influencing the target industry vertical.
current_trends.title: Current Trends

emerging_trends.description: Emerging early-stage trends shaping the future of the sector.
emerging_trends.title: Emerging Trends

technology_trends.description: Key technological advancements and digital transformation trends.
technology_trends.title: Technology Trends

consumer_behavior_trends.description: Shifts in customer expectations, buying habits, and usage behavior.
consumer_behavior_trends.title: Consumer Behavior Trends

regulatory_trends.description: Evolving legal, compliance, policy, and governance trends.
regulatory_trends.title: Regulatory Trends

investment_trends.description: Venture funding, capital deployment, and investor focus trends.
investment_trends.title: Investment Trends

sustainability_trends.description: ESG, environmental impact, and sustainability trends.
sustainability_trends.title: Sustainability Trends

future_predictions.description: Key predictions and projections for the industry over the next 3-5 years.
future_predictions.title: Future Predictions

opportunities_from_trends.description: Strategic opportunities created by these macro and tech trends.
opportunities_from_trends.title: Opportunities From Trends

risks_from_trends.description: Potential risks, disruption threats, or vulnerabilities introduced by trends.
risks_from_trends.title: Risks From Trends

trend_stability.description: Assessment of trend longevity and stability (e.g. Highly Stable, Volatile, Sustained Long-Term).
trend_stability.title: Trend Stability

trend_relevance.description: Relevance rating and impact magnitude of trends on the specific startup proposal.
trend_relevance.title: Trend Relevance

confidence_score.description: Confidence score rating strictly between 0.0 and 1.0.
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score

citations.description: Source URLs backing the claims above, when external research (Tavily/Exa/Zyte) was supplied in the prompt. Optional and defaults empty so this schema stays backward compatible with LLM-only reasoning when no research bundle is available.
citations.title: Citations

title: TrendAnalysis
